subject: 16 powershell + 6 cisco boxes print a BASH prompt (user@host:cwd$) under a 'Windows PowerShell' banner - Terminal.js _getPromptText special-cases only 'windows'. Measured via unknown-command-dialect probe
description:
[2026-09-17 22:56] HANDOFF, prepared 2026-09-17 for the next pivot. Discovery is DONE; do not redo it, but DO re-derive the counts (a count in prose is stale on arrival).

DEFECT, exact: Terminal.js:931-939 _getPromptText() special-cases ONLY promptStyle === 'windows' (returns cwd + '>'); every other value falls through to the bash prompt `user@host:shortCwd$`. So a box declaring powershell or cisco shows a Linux prompt under its own banner.

WHY IT IS NOW SELF-CONTRADICTORY: _unknownCommandText IS dialect-aware (windows/powershell/cisco) as of 2026-09-16, so the SAME terminal prints a PowerShell-correct 'is not recognized' error ABOVE a bash prompt. One half of the dialect work landed and the other did not.

SCOPE, measured 2026-09-17: 16 powershell + 6 cisco = 22 boxes. powershell: ad001-ad006, cld001-cld005, mob001-mob005 (ad004-new-hire, cld003-aad-sync, ad003-gpo-issues, mob004-wifi-cert, mob003-app-deploy, cld004-saas-access, mob002-lost-device, ad001-lockout-storm, cld001-teams-broken, cld005-cloud-outage, cld002-onedrive-sync, ad002-password-policy, mob001-mdm-enrollment, mob005-byod-compliance, ad005-permission-denied, ad006-replication-failure). cisco: vpn001-tunnel-down, vpn003-client-auth-fail, vpn004-performance-bottleneck, nt008-vlan-isolation, nt009-switch-port-down, nt010-routing-problem.

*** GREP TRAP — READ THIS BEFORE AUDITING *** 2 of the 6 cisco boxes and 1 windows box write promptStyle WITHOUT a space after the colon (promptStyle:'cisco'). An audit keyed on "promptStyle: '" silently MISSES 3 boxes and reports a clean partial sweep. Always derive with: grep -rlE \"promptStyle: *'X'|promptStyle:'X'\" _app --include=config.js. This is the detector-keyed-on-the-wrong-surface hazard, live, in this exact task.

NO BOX IS COMPENSATING: all 22 have ZERO _customPrompt references. So (a) there is no existing workaround to collide with, (b) there is NO in-repo evidence of the intended prompt string — the fix has to CHOOSE it, deliberately, rather than copy something. _customPrompt takes precedence at Terminal.js:933, and the boxes that do use it set it directly (e.g. _app/arena/boxes/e12-ecocide-engine/config.js:202 'term._customPrompt = prompt'), so a shared _getPromptText fix cannot double-fix them.

THE CISCO HALF IS NOT A ONE-LINER. PowerShell is a static shape (PS C:\\path>). Cisco is MODE-DEPENDENT: hostname> user EXEC, hostname# privileged after enable, hostname(config)# after configure terminal, hostname(config-if)# in an interface. A single static cisco string is WRONG for any box that models enable/configure terminal — check each of the 6 for whether it models modes, and drive those from state (that is what _customPrompt exists for) rather than hardcoding. Do not ship a static '#' and call the class closed.

BLAST RADIUS TO MEASURE BEFORE EDITING (scope the blast radius, not the diff):
1. ~/hexworth-shared/Solutions/Dispatch/*.md for these 22 boxes — if any walkthrough embeds the CURRENT bash prompt in expected output, the engine fix makes the docs wrong in the same stroke. Fix both or neither.
2. Any gate asserting prompt text: box-shell-consistency, unknown-command-dialect, walkthrough-verbatim.
3. Task 396 is COUPLED — the Confluence 'Lab Development Guide' already needs an edit about _unknownCommandText; a prompt change extends that same edit. Do them together, one outward-facing publish, operator authorizes.

VERIFICATION: _tools/hexos/unknown-command-dialect.test.js is what measured this and is the natural home. TWO FIXTURES per the detector rule — one powershell box and one cisco box — each asserting the CORRECT prompt renders AND the bash prompt does NOT appear. A single positive assertion passes for the wrong reason. Note the local-vs-prod split that probe already uses (95/95 local vs 0/N prod before the Terminal.js deploy) is the pattern for proving the fix reached production.

VALUE: 22 student-facing boxes, engine-local fix, and unlike the os003 token issue NOTHING server-side compensates — a student learning to recognise a PowerShell prompt is shown the wrong one. Recommended as the next box-work pivot.
